text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh... Which menu item should I go 
with?
choice_data_list:
Having trouble deciding what to get for 
lunch?

Can't decide what to get from the lunch 
menu?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm torn between choosing Falco-san's 
menu or Vodka-san's menu.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
It's exactly what it sounds like, though? 
We're eating the exact same meal that 
Falco and the others are eating.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Eating the exact same menu as your fave 
every single day— that's a luxury unique 
to the holy land of Tracen Academy!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Yesterday I had Ryan-san's 
menu, and the day before was Tamamo-san's 
menu! Ah, don't worry, I made sure the 
nutritional balance is on point too!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
When it's Spe-san or Oguri-san, Digitan's 
personal rule is to order the exact same 
menu, just with a smaller portion.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ordering the same menu as my oshi... That 
is canon fuel that expands the imagination 
to infinity...

Figuring calling her out would only drag 
out the conversation, I silently handed 
the tray over to Agnes Digital.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Gfufu~, let's have lunch and talk about 
our favorites♪ Oh, hey, Trainer, why don't 
you pick what I should order?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Which menu do you think is better, 
Falco-san's or Vodka-san's?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
That's a Falco-san menu with careful 
attention paid even to the presentation 
aesthetics!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Falco-san always starts with the 
salad, so I'll do the same—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Digital-chan, mind if I sit next 
to you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wha!? Falco-san!? Huh? Um, we'll get out 
of your way...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
No way, that's not it! I want to eat it 
together with Digital-chan.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Trainer, may I come in?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, thank you very much♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I knew it! Digital-chan, you ordered 
the exact same thing as Falco~! I caught a 
glimpse earlier and was wondering.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaargh! I am so sorry for copying you, 
sir!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"You respect me? Yay, that makes me so 
happy! ☆ Then let's take a picture 
together~"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
A fan told me before that they wanted to 
enter Tracen Academy. So I thought maybe 
photos could give them a glimpse of 
academy life.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"For the fans... O-Ohhh... As expected of 
Falco-san... A true model Umadol! So 
precious... Max preciousness...!!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Would it be okay if I posted the lunch 
photo with Digital-chan on Umatter...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Fwah!? A-A photo with me!? Well, any fan 
of Falco is an ally of mine, so I don't 
mind at all, but...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, then let's take it together♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yeah, looking good☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if they'll check Umart~ You know, 
that girl is apparently really good on 
dirt too.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So, I've been giving training tips in my 
fan letter replies. What kind of training 
do you usually do, Digital-chan?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure if this helps, but... 
Whenever the training track condition is 
either Firm or Bad, I try to run on dirt 
instead.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Special training on a heavy, sticky 
track! Your legs tend to slip away easily 
here~."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Also, about dealing with the sand kicked 
up from ahead... Maybe we could have a few 
runners match pace with her?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, that's so true! Though I'm a Front 
Runner, so our tactics won't overlap 
much!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Digital-chan's dirt training is on point 
too...! Hmm, Falco can't afford to fall 
behind either~.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no! I'm not even close yet! I'm 
nowhere near Falco-san's level!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Saying that won't make me let my guard 
down, you know! ☆ I've already marked you 
as my rival!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Nnngh!! ...I-I am utterly unworthy of such 
an honor...!

After that, Agnes Digital and Smart Falcon 
continued talking about dirt training, 
spending a very productive lunchtime 
together.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
How about we dig into a hearty Vodka-style 
meal!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: "Hey, why are you sitting next to me?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"It's not like I wanted to sit next to 
you. There just weren't any other seats 
open, so I had no choice."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yup yup! You understand completely. As 
expected of a fellow moe comrade, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Eating the exact same menu while imagining 
the conversation Vodka-san and the others 
had... You can totally lose yourself in 
it!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Vodka-san took Scarlet-san's 
shrimp!? ..."What do you think you're 
snagging, huh!?"

Throughout the entire meal after that, 
Agnes Digital kept voice-dubbing Vodka and 
Daiwa Scarlet. ...Quite a niche way to 
enjoy herself.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Phew, I'm so full! That was a deeply 
satisfying lunch break.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Digital, do you have a moment? There's 
something I'd like to check with you.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You were mimicking our conversation in the 
cafeteria earlier, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hiiik?! I-I am s-so terribly sorry!! Now 
that it's come to this, I shall commit 
seppuku to atone for my failure!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Seppuku?! Why?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's because you're glaring at it, 
Scarlet. Look, it's trembling so much 
because of you...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, watching Scarlet-san and 
Vodka-san fight live from this close... 
Heheheheh.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"...I wasn't, though! It just totally 
sounded like you were interrogating me!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...I'm not mad or anything. I just 
couldn't believe you heard us from that 
far away. Isn't your hearing a little too 
good?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I was just recreating it from 
imagination... I couldn't actually hear 
the conversation.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Imagination!? But that matched our 
conversation down to the word!? You're 
telling me you weren't even lip-reading?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, it's just my imagination... Umm... 
by the way, how did you two realize I was 
imitating you?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Dude, you were talking super loud. Right 
to your Trainer."
choice_data_list: Was I so absorbed I didn't even notice...?
I was so absorbed I didn't even notice...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I AM TRULY SORRY FOR EXISTING!!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Why are your apologies so heavy every 
single time!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Wait, recreating it from imagination? 
Isn't that pretty amazing too?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...It just goes to show how thoroughly 
Digital has researched all of us, huh..."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Then I'm gonna study you too! Digital, 
let's have a match running together! Once 
you battle someone, you pretty much 
understand 'em!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hey, it's not fair that only you get to! 
I'm going to run alongside Digital too!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huuuh? You tryin' to cut in?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
A one-match showdown lets Digital go all 
out, right? ...Oh? Are you afraid of 
losing to me?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That's my line! All right, let's make it a 
three-way showdown!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
T-The three of us...? I'll get to watch 
Scarlet-san and Vodka-san battle it out... 
from the best seat in the house...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Whoaaaaaaa~~~~~~!!

Agnes Digital ascended with a blissful 
look on her face. —That said, the 
after-school tandem training itself turned 
out to be very fruitful.
